findings.note: The Summary opens with: this is the first and only code path in this feature that writes a live artifact, so every live write -- on a clean resolve and on a Block alike -- now goes through one journaled transaction. That is the WITHDRAWN route, not the shipped behaviour. In the staged resolver carried by this bundle, _write_evidence performs a direct temp file + fsync + rename with no staging area and no journal, and the module docstring states the script has exactly TWO live-filesystem write routes. The report itself withdraws this description 45 lines below (WITHDRAWN 2026-08-28) and asserts that all four sites are corrected together here; this opening sentence is a fifth site that the sweep missed, so the report's primary narrative still tells a reviewer that a Block's Evidence write is journaled. Same amendment-propagation class the report documents repeatedly, in the one paragraph most likely to be read first.

The bullet states eleven new fixture directories (listed under Outputs). The Outputs table in the same report lists thirteen distinct fixture scenario directories (artifact-publication-failed, clean-full-track-publication, post-publication-crash-before-evidence, post-publication-generation-mismatch, publication-fsync-failure, publication-journal-recovery, publication-journal-recovery-crash, publication-journal-roundtrip-unresolved-repo, publication-journal-target-escape, publication-staging-chain-fsync-failure, publication-staging-parent-symlink, publication-target-parent-symlink, snapshot-generation-mismatch-affected-components), and the very next paragraph of the SAME bullet states thirteen and claims those are now the ONLY live statements of that count in this report. Eleven was correct through about round 21 and went stale when rounds 22 and 24 added publication-fsync-failure and publication-staging-chain-fsync-failure. This is the exact class the round-25 remediation says was closed by a truth-comparing count verifier, surviving inside the paragraph that announces the closure.

The Python master is 2,505 lines, over the 500-line house guideline. The staged resolver carried in this bundle as a declared output is 3,526 lines. The disclosure's conclusion is unaffected (both exceed the guideline, splitting is out of scope), but it is another measurement-framed number in a declared output that is stale by about 40 percent at the shipped bytes, and the rewritten count verifier evidently does not cover claims of this kind.
